verdict.rationale: monday.com ships AI agents and routes data to model providers, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it, but no evidence documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI training. The nearest items are hosting-security claims ('data never leaves our secure servers', SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO certification) and 'trusted AI connectors'. These are adjacent security controls, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
